question: A shopkeeper marked the price of an article at 10% higher than its cost price. He then gives two successive discount of 5% each. What is his loss or profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Percentage marked above cost price is 10%.
 
• Two successive discounts is 5% each.

**Formula used:**

 
• Loss = cost price - selling price
 
• Loss percentage = (loss/cost price) ×100
